chapter: Boyhood in Webster Groves and early roadhouse work
title: Parents' music: his mother's choir singing
summary: Asked if his parents were musical, Thomas describes his mother's plaintive choir voice and says he played spirituals on trumpet in that choir.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, were your parents musical at all?
Well, Stan, I thought so. My mother sang in the choir. She had not a trained voice but a very plaintive voice and I had it had something to say
a chance to play in that choir some years ago as a boy.
